items.q: paul barberin tells about once on a parade

wood paul barberin tells about once on a parade when sydney either lost the clarinet or something and they uh they had to have a parade and they got him in the last minute and he didn't have his clarinet or maybe he didn't even own one and he went to a pawn shop and got some old yellow it looked like a bamboo thing paul said but he said he should have heard him play on that thing um raymond burke has one similar to this too i'll show it to you that's a probably a hundred year old instrument and i imagine maybe uh…

last week they did a funeral over in algiers and i was talking with uh uh the humphrey brother the the one who plays saxophone yeah willie willie and he was telling about sydney he says remember sydney coming on a job once with a mouthpiece on the clarinet there was about a quarter of an inch broken off the front of the tip of the mouthpiece you know it had hit something it was just a jagged edge he says played sydney put a read on that thing and made it play and he says i don't know how he did it you know yeah…
